I counted 4 ready CLs + Prysm from messages, so that makes it 5 <@358120958726373381> lh forking already Looks to be some peer scoring bug again 🙁 grandine <> neth bug you can create a thread without posting a message, you know that? yeah lighthouse seems to be forking away immediately testing matrix I'm using now: ```yaml participants_matrix: el: - el_type: ethrex el_image: ethpandaops/ethrex:glamsterdam-devnet-5 - el_type: nethermind el_image: ethpandaops/nethermind:glamsterdam-devnet-5 cl: - cl_type: lodestar cl_image: ethpandaops/lodestar:glamsterdam-devnet-5 - cl_type: lighthouse cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:glamsterdam-devnet-5 - cl_type: grandine cl_image: ethpandaops/grandine:glamsterdam-devnet-5-minimal - cl_type: nimbus cl_image: ethpandaops/nimbus-eth2:glamsterdam-devnet-5-minimal network_params: preset: minimal gloas_fork_epoch: 1 withdrawal_type: "0x01" validator_balance: 40000 genesis_gaslimit: 150000000 gas_limit: 150000000 additional_services: - assertoor - spamoor - dora assertoor_params: run_stability_check: false run_block_proposal_check: false tests: - { file: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethpandaops/assertoor/refs/heads/master/playbooks/gloas-dev/builder-lifecycle.yaml" } port_publisher: additional_services: enabled: true ``` I think lodestar isn’t serving columns for epoch 0 once we fork to Gloas. Lighthouse custody backfill syncs and peers at epoch 0 aren’t serving columns as expected. That’s the only peer scoring issue, I disabled peer scoring for custody column backfill in the previous devnet. Can do it again, but there’s a bug somewhere and I’m pretty sure it’s not us you should be able to get the columns from others? if it’s a lodestar only bug others would score them down too no? Nobody else custody backfills Our cgc changes after genesis so we go back and backfill missing columns from epoch 0 using something similar testing locally my branch I don’t know if it’s only lodestar, but I saw lodestar peers doing this last time <@412614104222531604> what the heck is this? ``` There was an error interpreting Starlark code Evaluation error: Multiple errors caught interpreting the Starlark script. Listing each of them below. at [github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/src/zkboost/zkboost_launcher.star:311:17]: undefined: GpuConfig (did you mean get_config?) at [github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/main.star:67:24]: <toplevel> Error encountered running Starlark code. ``` I think you need to update kurtosis. again 😭 I’ll build an image to not penalize peers for custody backfill again, but there’s def a bug floating around somewhere Testing with this ``` participants_matrix: el: - el_type: ethrex el_image: ethpandaops/ethrex:glamsterdam-devnet-5 - el_type: nethermind el_image: ethpandaops/nethermind:glamsterdam-devnet-5 cl: - cl_type: lodestar cl_image: ethpandaops/lodestar:glamsterdam-devnet-5 - cl_type: prysm cl_image: prysm-bn-custom-image:latest vc_image: prysm-vc-custom-image:latest network_params: preset: minimal gloas_fork_epoch: 1 withdrawal_type: "0x01" validator_balance: 40000 genesis_gaslimit: 150000000 gas_limit: 150000000 additional_services: - assertoor - spamoor - dora assertoor_params: run_stability_check: false run_block_proposal_check: false tests: - { file: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethpandaops/assertoor/refs/heads/master/playbooks/gloas-dev/builder-lifecycle.yaml" } ``` If it doesn´t fork at gloas I'll push the branch Ok, pushing <@412614104222531604> I think it's fine, but you need to test slashings before the fork for 8045 (and probably fork after epoch 2) branch is `glamsterdam-devnet-5` update I have lodekeeper on that, let's see, need to review our FCR implementation right now

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
```yaml
participants_matrix:
  el:
    - el_type: ethrex
      el_image: ethpandaops/ethrex:glamsterdam-devnet-5
    - el_type: nethermind
      el_image: ethpandaops/nethermind:glamsterdam-devnet-5
  cl:
    - cl_type: lodestar
      cl_image: ethpandaops/lodestar:glamsterdam-devnet-5
    - cl_type: lighthouse
      cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:glamsterdam-devnet-5
    - cl_type: grandine
      cl_image: ethpandaops/grandine:glamsterdam-devnet-5-minimal
    - cl_type: nimbus
      cl_image: ethpandaops/nimbus-eth2:glamsterdam-devnet-5-minimal
network_params:
  preset: minimal
  gloas_fork_epoch: 1
  withdrawal_type: "0x01"
  validator_balance: 40000
  genesis_gaslimit: 150000000
  gas_limit: 150000000

additional_services:
   - assertoor
   - spamoor
   - dora

assertoor_params:
  run_stability_check: false
  run_block_proposal_check: false
  tests:
    - { file: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethpandaops/assertoor/refs/heads/master/playbooks/gloas-dev/builder-lifecycle.yaml" }


port_publisher:
  additional_services:
    enabled: true




```
